parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate the separation of the plates.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: A nucleus of mass $8.3 \times 10^{-27} \text{kg}$ is now placed in the electric field. The electric force acting on the nucleus is $6.7 \times 10^{-15} \text{N}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the charge on the nucleus in terms of $e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the mass, in $\text{u}$, of the nucleus.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers in (b)(i) and (b)(ii) to determine the number of neutrons in the nucleus.

stem: A uniform electric field is produced between two parallel metal plates. The electric field strength is $1.4 \times 10^4 \text{N C}^{-1}$. The potential difference between the plates is $350 \text{V}$.
